$comment: The extras of omx-flanger's declaration: what its descriptor, omx-flanger.descriptor.json, has no word for (docs/declaration-as-descriptor.md). The two are the folder's hand-written files; tools/gen.mjs generates the rest and writes the travels the descriptor's links resolve to. Its parameters are by reference to omx-contract's flanger kernel and bind by name to omx-dsp's instance face. Control order, the descriptor's, is append-only.

console.$comment: The OpenMixer console draws its flanger stage: the modulation panel (rateHz, depthMs, feedback, mix). Its chip shows rateHz; the overview card shows the engage switch only.
